QF.id: AIFM CII Fund Performance and Benchmarking_21

question.text: Under SEBI's benchmarking operational guidelines (Box 7.3), performance data and benchmarks must be reported in:

answer.text: The currency of the lead investor's domicile.

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Box 7.3(l) of the workbook (page 163): performance data and benchmarks shall be reported in both INR and USD terms. The dual-currency requirement is the operational rule in the benchmarking framework. The Trap: INR-only and USD-only each ignore one leg of the explicit Box 7.3(l) requirement. Lead-investor-domicile currency is not specified anywhere in the SEBI guideline. Note: The relevant text appears in Box 7.3(l); the requirement is a single sentence and does not invoke any specific FX source or inspection consequence beyond the dual-reporting rule itself.
